response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS u WHERE u.ID = p.ID AND u.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(u.`U-PRO`) NOT IN ('', '-')) GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM per_patient GROUP BY SEX

assumptions.assumption: An empty or whitespace-only U-PRO value is not a recorded result. A ratio with GPT equal to zero is undefined and is ignored by AVG.
